refnamediv.refpurpose: Finds lines in a binary image using the probabilistic Hough transform

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: lines = HoughLinesP(img, distance_res, angle_res, threshold[, minLineLength[, maxLineGap]])

listitem.para: Minimum line length, shorter lines are rejected (double).
Maximum allowed gap between points on the same line to link them (double).
Output matrix of lines. Each column represents a line, coded in cartesian coordinates system ((x1, y1), (x2, y2)). (double 4xn).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: HoughLinesP find the line segments in an image using the probabilistic Hough transform. To apply, first an edge detection pre-processing is necessary. It keeps track of the intersection between curves of every point in the image. If the number of intersections is above the value of threshold, then the line is output in cartesian coordinates ((x1, y1), (x2, y2)).
